vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: haodf
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle consists of metadata and markdown instructions (SKILL.md) designed to guide an AI agent in helping users find doctors. It contains no executable code, network requests, or data exfiltration logic, and includes appropriate medical disclaimers. The instructions are strictly aligned with the stated purpose of medical specialty mapping and doctor recommendations.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only doctor-finding helper whose claimed purpose matches its instructions and it requests no credentials or installs; main practical concern is handling sensitive health/location data and lack of explicit source attribution for doctor ratings.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and runtime instructions align: the skill maps symptoms to specialties, filters by location, evaluates doctors, and recommends options. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or installs required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md stays within the stated purpose (symptom-to-specialty mapping and recommending doctors). It is vague about data sources — 'check ratings, experience, patient reviews' but does not specify which APIs/websites to use; this implies the agent may perform web searches or call external services at runtime, which could transmit user-provided health/location details unless restricted.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk or downloaded during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or special config paths. Requested capabilities are proportionate to the described functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system privileges or modify other skills. Autonomous invocation is allowed by platform default but is not elevated here.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and does not ask for credentials or install anything. Before using it, remember: (1) it is a finder/recommendation tool, not medical advice — follow the included medical disclaimer and seek licensed care for diagnoses or emergencies; (2) it will prompt for sensitive personal health and location information — avoid sharing identifying details you don't want sent to web searches or external services; (3) because the SKILL.md doesn't name data sources, verify any recommended doctors/hospitals independently (official hospital sites or verified directories) before booking; (4) if you are concerned about privacy, restrict the agent's network access or disable autonomous invocation so queries are performed manually and you can control what is sent externally; (5) if a future version starts requesting API keys or credentials (e.g., to integrate with haodf.com), treat that as a significant change and review the requested permissions carefully.
